study type: Population-based cohort study with a sibling control design
exposure: Small for gestational age (SGA) severe (<3rd percentile)
Small for gestational age (SGA) moderate (3rd to <10th percentile)
outcome: Childhood mortality from 28 days to <18 years
cohort: The study included 3,795,603 non-malformed singleton live births and 2,781,464 full siblings born in Sweden from January 1, 1973, to December 31, 2012.
finding: SGA, especially severe SGA, was associated with an increased risk of childhood death beyond the neonatal period, with the highest risk estimates for death from infection and neurologic disease.
followup_time: From 28 days to less than 18 years after birth
